cases.sentence: Возьми этот сосуд с ___ и ступай в Рамот Галаадский.
cases.translation: Take this vial with oil and go to Ramoth Gilead.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the genitive case.
The preposition на (on) with accusative indicates direction.

cases.translation: I anoint you as king of Israel.
cases.explain: The verb помазываю with в takes the instrumental for predicate nominative.
The genitive follows the adjective in the phrase.
The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Стрела пронзила ему ___ и он осел в колеснице.
cases.translation: An arrow pierced his heart and he sank in his chariot.
cases.explain: The transitive verb пронзила (pierced) takes the accusative case.
The preposition в with location meaning governs the prepositional case.

cases.translation: She began to look out the window.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location meaning governs the prepositional case.
